d.d: To repent of or regret (some past action or event); to wish that a past action or event had not taken place.
Any of various perennial shrubs of the genus Ruta, especially the herb Ruta graveolens (common rue), formerly used in medicines.
A kind of salsa round dance.
Causing, feeling, or expressing regret or sorrow, especially in a wry or humorous way.
In a rueful manner; causing, feeling, or expressing regret or sorrow.
third-person singular simple present indicative of rue
